grouped_metrics.interpretation: Each partition assigns each image once. Coverage tags overlap; do not sum them. Each group independently reranks its predictions for AP; group AP is not additive. Frames from one session are correlated, and these are descriptive subgroup results.

latency_ms.timing_scope: detect(frame) only; includes detector preprocessing/decoding, excludes PNG I/O

limitations: Synthetic fixture results do not establish accuracy on real recordings.
A split named test does not prove the model never saw those images elsewhere.
AP uses a declared confidence cutoff and one IoU; this is not COCO mAP50-95.
Small image counts yield uncertain accuracy and latency estimates.

metrics.ap_definition: 101-point interpolated precision envelope after confidence filtering
